instrument_semantics.fail_closed: non-zero exit on REWRITTEN or REMOVED; SUPERSEDED/RESTORED are recorded verdict changes, not evidence loss

states.RESTORED: bytes equal an earlier observation of the same path (rollback; recorded, exit 0)
states.REWRITTEN: bytes changed with no hash-bearing pointer to the replaced bytes (silent loss, fail closed, exit 2)
states.SUPERSEDED: bytes changed and the replacement contains the replaced sha256 as a hex token (acknowledged, exit 0)
states.TOUCHED: bytes identical, mtime moved (not a rewrite)
states.UNCHANGED: bytes and mtime identical to the latest observation

instrument_semantics.write_once_store: store/<sha256>.json is created only if absent; every prior verdict byte sequence that was ever seeded remains readable
